list.title: Plugins
list.subtitle: Add optional Tilecast features and integrations to this installation.
list.unsupportedTitle: Plugins from a newer Tilecast release
list.unsupportedBody_one: {{ids}} is recorded as installed but not part of this release. It will not run, and its data is kept for when the newer release returns.
list.unsupportedBody_other: {{ids}} are recorded as installed but not part of this release. They will not run, and their data is kept for when the newer release returns.
list.retiredBody_one: {{ids}} is recorded as installed but was removed from Tilecast. It no longer runs, and its data is kept.
list.retiredBody_other: {{ids}} are recorded as installed but were removed from Tilecast. They no longer run, and their data is kept.
list.emptyDescription: Add only the optional features this Tilecast installation needs.

catalog.installNote: An Owner or Administrator can install plugins.
catalog.title: Add a plugin
catalog.description: Optional features built into this Tilecast release. Installing one never downloads code.
catalog.emptyInstalledDescription: This installation already uses every plugin this release offers.

actionsMenu.removeDescription: {{name}} leaves this installation's Plugins list and stops affecting screens. You can add it again at any time.
actionsMenu.blockedEmpty: This plugin is still in use.
actionsMenu.blockedWait: Wait for the {{labels}} to clear, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDisable: Turn off the {{disable}} on this page, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDelete: Delete the remaining {{labels}} on this page, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDisableDelete: Turn off the {{disable}} and delete the remaining {{labels}} on this page, then remove the plugin.

gate.lockedDescription: {{description}} An Owner or Administrator can install it.

shared.manageNote: Owner or Administrator access is required to make changes.

history.subtitle: Measurements the player recorded locally and delivered on its ordinary heartbeat.
history.privacyNotice: Noise history stores relative noise-level measurements for graphs and reports. Tilecast never records or stores microphone audio. Levels are relative to each player's own microphone and are not calibrated decibel measurements.
history.screenHint: Levels are relative to each player's own microphone, so screens are compared with care.
history.exportTitle: Export the selected range and screen
history.combining: Combining {{count}} screens. Each player's levels come from its own microphone, so a combined view describes the group rather than comparing rooms.
history.emptyDescription: History appears once a targeted Linux player has been measuring and has delivered a heartbeat.
history.chartDescription: Average and peak, against this meter's own thresholds. Periods with no monitoring are left blank.

chart.aria: Noise Level over time. Warning level {{warning}}, too loud level {{loud}}.
chart.description: Average and peak Noise Level are shown over time. Gaps indicate periods with no monitoring. The warning threshold is {{warning}}; the too-loud threshold is {{loud}}.

history.dailyDescription: Days without monitoring are omitted rather than shown as silent.
